position_traversal.sentinel_shape: FF FF FF FF <selector> FF FF FF
position_traversal.skip_contract: PositionF==1 sections can be skipped by scanning to the next recognized position marker; terminal/skip cases rewind one 8-byte position record before outer traversal resumes.

version_conditioned_fields.frame_id_upgrade: 通信フレームのID changes to WORD/2 bytes when バージョン_L5_1(ObjectVer) > 3
version_conditioned_fields.help_id_upgrade: へルプID changes to DWORD/4 bytes when バージョン_L5_1(ObjectVer) > 2

gtse_compression.archive: ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory with Shift-JIS entry encoding, then File.Move .zip to .GTSE
gtse_compression.manifest: list.txt encoded Shift-JIS with Target Folder header

legacy_upgrade.boundary: Historical TSE files are normalized by native GTSFileController before the current managed template reader. A legacy specimen can validate format lineage and the native-upgrade input boundary without being assumed byte-layout-identical to 180_Template.csv.
legacy_upgrade.pipeline: source TSE -> native GFCConvertOldTSEToLatestTSE -> upgraded _NEW.TSE -> BinaryRead with configured template

ring_buffer_parser.record_width: Binary records contain a 4-byte little-endian UInt32 timestamp and sum(frame byte lengths) data bytes. The parser processes 8 + 2 * sum(frame byte lengths) hexadecimal characters.
ring_buffer_parser.unsigned_decode: UInt64 parse, bit-mask, then right shift

title: GTS+ recovered TSE/GTSE managed procedural semantics
validation_boundary: Procedural host semantics are recovered. Public legacy Toyota-generated TSE specimens validate the shared header/FAT/position-marker lineage, while a true-TSS3 TSE is still required to exercise current PCS Operation/Image FFD population and the complete latest-layout traversal end-to-end.
